name: factr-test
description: Design falsifiable tests, discover evidence and bindings, and render supported scenarios.

interface.shortDescription: Design tests, discover evidence, and render scenarios.
interface.longDescription: Independent behavioral testing using FACTR Core. Design observable cases, inspect relevant contracts and bindings when needed, and render Gherkin or supported automation while preserving uncertainty and evidence provenance.
defaultPrompt: Use FACTR Test to design falsifiable tests from this description.
Use FACTR Test to discover the evidence and bindings these tests need.
Use FACTR Test to render this behavior as Gherkin and identify unbound steps.
